jobs.title: Director - Technology
jobs.description:
Overview:

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.  

This Director role is part of the Audit Technology \& Transformation team within KPMG Canada’s Audit practice, leading technology strategy, innovation, and transformation initiatives. The role partners with Audit leadership and technology stakeholders to advance AI, data, analytics, automation, and emerging technology solutions that support the modernization of the Audit practice.
What you will do:
* Lead the development and execution of the Audit Technology \& Transformation strategy, aligning technology initiatives with the evolving needs of the Audit practice.
* Provide leadership across AI, data and analytics, automation, and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to modernize and enhance audit delivery.
* Partner with Audit leadership, technology teams, and other stakeholders to design and implement scalable technology solutions.
* Oversee technology transformation initiatives from strategy through implementation, ensuring appropriate governance, prioritization, and delivery.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the firm to enable collaboration and adoption of new technologies and ways of working.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team, creating an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives and experiences are valued.
* Monitor technology and industry trends and assess opportunities to responsibly introduce innovative solutions within the Audit practice.
* Support effective change management and stakeholder engagement to drive successful adoption of technology\-enabled solutions.


What you bring to this role:
* Education: University degree in technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Experience: Senior leadership experience delivering large\-scale technology transformation within a complex professional or enterprise environment.
* Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of AI, data and analytics, automation, cloud technologies, and emerging technology, with experience translating these capabilities into practical business solutions
* Delivery: Demonstrated experience leading technology initiatives from strategy and planning through implementation and adoption, including governance and stakeholder management.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead and develop teams and collaborate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders in a complex organization

 **KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information**
The expected base salary range for this position is $117,000 \- $196,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, \& competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program. **Providing you with the support you need to be at your best**  


Our Values, The KPMG Way:
**Integrity**, we do what is right \| **Excellence**, we never stop learning and improving \| **Courage**, we think and act boldly \| **Together**, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences \| **For Better**, we do what matters  

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier\-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice. **Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process**  

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1\-888\-466\-4778\. **AI Usage**  

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.  

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology\-first, people\-driven firm.

jobs.title: Director, Client Technology & Data Solutions
jobs.description:
**POSITION DESCRIPTION**  

**ROLE:** Director, Client Technology \& Data Solutions  

**LOCATION:** Oakville (Hybrid \- 2 days a week)  

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**



We are seeking an experienced **Director, Client Technology \& Data Solutions** to lead two interconnected areas of Encore's technology\-enabled business: **client technology solutions and the Information Services function**.



This is a leadership role with accountability for the commercial and operational success of technology\-enabled client engagements. You will serve as the primary bridge between client business requirements and Encore's technology, data and reporting capabilities, working closely with Information Services, Development, IT/Security, Client Service and Business Development.



You will lead technology\-enabled client relationships, translate business needs into practical and scalable solutions, and ensure strong service delivery from Encore's Information Services team. You will also identify opportunities to expand client relationships, improve how services are delivered, and thoughtfully apply emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled capabilities.



The successful candidate combines technology and data expertise, commercial acumen, people leadership and disciplined service delivery.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Client Technology \& Commercial Leadership**


* Serve as the senior technology relationship lead for clients using Encore technology solutions.
* Translate client business requirements into clearly defined technology, data, integration and reporting solutions.
* Own the commercial performance of technology\-enabled client engagements, including revenue, gross margin, cost\-to\-serve, forecasting and expansion opportunities.
* Partner with Business Development on solution scoping, estimation, pricing, proposals and opportunities to expand Encore's technology services.

### **Information Services Leadership**


* Lead Encore's Information Services function, responsible for capabilities including data transformation, integrations, reporting and field data collection design.
* Establish priorities and align team capacity with organizational requirements.
* Own the Information Services service\-delivery model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, commitments, performance management and escalation.
* Monitor delivery quality, timeliness, workload, backlog and service risks.
* Establish meaningful service and performance measures and provide leadership with visibility to performance, capacity, risks and investment needs.

### **Technology Enablement \& Continuous Improvement**


* Maintain a strong understanding of Encore's technology environment, applications, reporting capabilities, data flows and integrations.
* Partner with Development and other technology stakeholders to assess feasibility, prioritize work and align solution development with available capacity.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled solutions, where they can materially improve client outcomes, service quality, productivity or scalability.

### **Governance \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**


* Lead cross\-functional alignment between Information Services, Development, IT/Security, Client Service, and other stakeholders.
* Establish appropriate data quality and governance practices across data transformation, integrations and reporting.
* Ensure solutions align with applicable privacy, security, contractual and data\-handling requirements in partnership with the appropriate internal teams.
* Promote clear documentation of data flows, business rules, dependencies and operating procedures to strengthen supportability and business continuity.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* **10\+ years of progressively senior experience** with meaningful accountability across technology/data solutions, client relationships and people leadership.
* Experience in an agency, professional services, consulting or other multi\-client environment is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing technology\-enabled B2B client relationships and complex solution requirements.
* Strong people\-leadership capabilities, including prioritization, coaching, resource planning, accountability and capability development.
* Strong knowledge of data transformation, data integration, data quality and data governance.
* Experience establishing service\-delivery practices, managing competing priorities and improving service quality in a multi\-stakeholder environment.
* Working understanding of privacy, security, access and data\-handling considerations relevant to client technology solutions.
* Strong commercial and financial judgment, with the ability to balance client requirements, capacity, cost, risk and business value.
* Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to work effectively with clients, technical teams and senior business leaders.

jobs.title: Director, SAP Finance Transformation & Enterprise Solutions
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care.


What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.


**About the Role**
------------------

  

  

McKesson is seeking a strategic and results\-driven **Director, SAP Finance Transformation \& Enterprise Solutions** to lead large\-scale finance transformation initiatives across General Ledger, Treasury, and enterprise finance capabilities. This leader will drive business and technology modernization efforts, develop strategic roadmaps, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver innovative SAP S/4HANA solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, compliance, and business outcomes.


The role combines finance process expertise, solution architecture leadership, transformational program management, and business consulting capabilities to enable McKesson's long\-term growth strategy.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Lead enterprise\-wide finance transformation initiatives involving Record\-to\-Report (R2R), and related finance processes.


* Define and execute strategic roadmaps for SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities and supporting technology platforms.


* Serve as the solution architecture leader for complex finance and treasury initiatives, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards.


* Build compelling business cases, investment analyses, and value realization strategies that support executive decision\-making.


* Partner with business leaders, finance organizations, and technology teams to identify opportunities for process optimization and digital transformation.


* Lead large cross\-functional programs from strategy through implementation, change adoption, and business value realization.


* Oversee integrations between SAP S/4HANA Finance and upstream/downstream business processes, including MM (Materials Management) and SD (Sales \& Distribution).


* Influence executive stakeholders, vendors, and delivery partners to achieve strategic business objectives.


**Basic Requirements**
----------------------


* 10\+ years of progressive experience in finance technology, finance transformation, enterprise applications, or consulting leadership roles.


* Hands\-on experience with Record to Report and Treasury business processes and supporting technology solutions.


* Experience leading SAP S/4HANA transformation programs within large, complex enterprises.


* Experience implementing or supporting SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions.


* Experience with SAP Finance configuration and integrations across MM and SD modules.


* Proven Solution Architecture experience designing enterprise finance technology solutions.


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including development of business cases, investment justification, and value realization frameworks.


* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
-------------------------------


* Consulting experience in business process transformation, operating model design, or corporate strategy.


* Knowledge of Treasury Management, Cash Management, Financial Close, Accounting Operations, and Financial Planning processes.


* Experience working with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Procurement, and Supply Chain functions.


* Familiarity with enterprise integration platforms, APIs, cloud technologies, and modern architecture frameworks.


* Experience managing strategic technology vendors and system integrators.


* Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or related discipline).


* Experience within healthcare, pharmaceutical, distribution, or regulated industries.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 277846
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

**Director \& Head, Global Capital Markets (GCM) Product, GCM Transformation – Toronto, ON**

  

**Global Banking and Markets**

Global Banking and Markets (GBM) conducts the Bank’s wholesale banking and capital markets business with corporate, government and institutional investor clients. GBM is a full\-service wholesale bank and investment dealer in Canada and Mexico and offers a range of products and services in the U.S., Latin America and in select markets in Europe and Asia\-Pacific.

  

More specifically, GBM provides clients with: corporate lending; transaction banking (including payments, trade finance and cash management); investment banking (including corporate finance and mergers \& acquisitions); fixed income and equity underwriting, sales, trading and research; prime services (prime brokerage and stock lending); foreign exchange sales and trading; commodity derivatives; and collateral management.

  

**Purpose**


The Director \& Head, GCM Product, contributes to defining and executing the product vision, roadmap and delivery strategy for one or more Global Capital Markets (GCM) investment journeys. The role is responsible for aligning business strategy, investment priorities and engineering capacity to deliver measurable business outcomes across trading, sales, financing, structured products, commodities, FX, equities and supporting platforms. The Director partners closely with Front Office, Operations, Technology, Risk, Finance and Data teams to drive product discovery, prioritization, delivery and value realization while modernizing platforms, automating workflows, improving controls and enhancing client and employee experiences. The role acts as the primary product leader for their investment journey, ensuring clear ownership from strategy through execution and adoption.

  

**What You'll Do**


* Contributes to defining and maintaining the product vision, strategy and multi\-year roadmap for assigned Capital Markets investment journeys, ensuring alignment to GBM strategic priorities, revenue objectives, risk management requirements and technology modernization goals


* Owns product backlog prioritization and investment sequencing by balancing business value, client impact, regulatory requirements, operational efficiency, technology dependencies, capacity constraints and benefits realization


* Acts as business product lead and subject matter expert for assigned Capital Markets platforms and workflows across front, middle and back\-office functions


* Partners with Desk Heads, Business Leads, Technology, Operations, Risk, Finance and Architecture teams to translate strategic objectives into product roadmaps, requirements, business capabilities and delivery priorities


* Leads discovery, business case development and prioritization activities to establish a transparent, value\-based investment backlog aligned to business outcomes and strategic objectives


* Drives modernization of trading, financing, risk, operations and client\-facing platforms through automation, workflow optimization, data integration and process simplification


* Partners with agile delivery teams establish sprint priorities, manage dependencies, remove delivery impediments and ensure successful execution against committed outcomes


* Establishes and monitors product performance metrics, including revenue enablement, client adoption, operational efficiency, risk reduction, platform stability, delivery predictability and business value realization


* Supports governance forums including portfolio planning, backlog refinement, prioritization reviews and executive reporting to provide transparency across demand, capacity, delivery and outcomes


* Maintains strong knowledge of Capital Markets products including FX, Fixed Income, Commodities, Equities, Financing, Structured Finance and post\-trade processes, while evaluating emerging technologies and market trends to enhance business capabilities

  

**What You'll Bring**


* Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Technology, Engineering or related field. MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred


* 10\+ years of leadership experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Sales \& Trading, Product Management, Technology or Transformation


* Deep understanding of one or more Capital Markets domains including Fixed Income, FX, Commodities, Equities, Financing, Prime Services, Structured Finance or Trade Lifecycle Management


* Proven experience leading large\-scale platform modernization, digital transformation and operating model initiatives


* Strong knowledge of Agile product management, backlog prioritization and outcome\-based delivery methodologies


* Experience managing complex stakeholder groups including Front Office, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Finance

  

**Work Arrangement:**

This position is an onsite role, with the expectation that you will work 5 days a week in the office. Please note that this is subject to change based on the needs of the business.


\#LI\-Onsite \#GBM

  

**Interested?**

At Scotiabank, you’ll be joining an organization that values inclusion, accountability, innovative thinking and collaboration, a culture where people feel safe to learn, grow, and contribute while delivering exceptional results for our clients. We believe in winning together, as one team, strengthening the collaborative spirit that defines GBM’s client partnerships. We value transparency, shared goals, and purposeful work.

  

**What's in it for you?**

Scotiabank wants you to be able to bring your best self to work – and life, every day. With a focus on holistic well\-being, our many flexible benefit programs are designed to help support your unique family, financial, physical, mental, and social health needs.

  



Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

------------------


The Financial Crime, Investigations \& Disputes practice helps organizations respond to complex business challenges involving fraud, misconduct, regulatory scrutiny, financial crime, disputes, and investigative matters. Our multidisciplinary teams combine deep industry knowledge, investigative expertise, advanced analytics, and innovative technologies to help clients identify, prevent, and respond to risk while protecting enterprise value and reputation.

* Build and enhance Deloitte's market profile through thought leadership, networking, and industry participation.

* Originate, sell, and deliver work across financial crimes advisory services.
* Function as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams, boards, legal counsel, and key stakeholders on sensitive and high\-profile matters.
* Manage and oversee a team of Financial Crimes professionals, provide coaching and mentoring to develop our future leaders.
* Mentor, coach, and develop practitioners while fostering a high\-performing team environment.
* Support the creation and execution of growth strategies and business plans.
  

  

**Key Attributes \& Competencies**
* Established leadership presence with strong professional credibility.
* Highly proficient and proven expertise in building or assessing Financial Crimes \& AML Programs.
* Strong understanding of financial crimes including AML and Fraud Risk Management services, Regulatory Compliance, and regulatory environments.
* Deep understanding of all applicable regulatory AML requirements in Canada, not only in theory but also understand how to operationalize and test AML / Anti\-Fraud controls. This includes but is not limited to subject matter expertise regarding the PCMLTFA, FINTRAC Guidelines, OSFI Guidelines, CIRO Rules, Global Affairs \& Economic Sanctions, Provincial Financial Services Regulations, etc.
* Excellent writing skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with C\-Suite Executive and Board of Directors.
* Demonstrated success developing and growing client relationships and business opportunities.

* Strong communication, influencing, and relationship\-building skills.

* Innovative thinker with an interest in technology\-enabled solutions.
* Deep commitment to professionalism and client service excellence.

**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------


This leadership opportunity is ideal for an established professional with expertise in financial crimes including AML program management, investigations, fraud risk management, anti\-corruption programs, regulatory matters, and related advisory services. The successful candidate will bring strong market credibility, trusted client relationships, and a demonstrated ability to originate and grow business opportunities while leading high\-performing teams and delivering complex client engagements.
  

  

Working closely with national leadership, this individual will play a key role in expanding Deloitte's presence across various regulated sectors across Canada while contributing to one of the country's leading forensic and financial crime practices.


**About the team**
------------------


The Financial Crime, Investigations \& Disputes practice helps organizations respond to complex business challenges involving fraud, misconduct, regulatory scrutiny, financial crime, disputes, and investigative matters. Our multidisciplinary teams combine deep industry knowledge, investigative expertise, advanced analytics, and innovative technologies to help clients identify, prevent, and respond to risk while protecting enterprise value and reputation.
  

  

As part of Deloitte's national network, practitioners collaborate across regions and service lines to deliver market\-leading solutions to public and private sector organizations across Canada.

* Lead the growth and development of Deloitte's Financial Crime practice across Canada.
* Work closely with and support the Financial Crimes Partners to lead day\-to\-day engagements and produce high\-quality deliverables to our clients.

* Established leadership presence with strong professional credibility.
